summary: hidden SU(4) (mu=4 dark colors) carrying the 128-spinor's SM families (N_f=16) has beta_0 = (44-32)/3 = 4 = mu > 0 -> asymptotically free + confining (vs visible QCD beta_0=Phi6=7).
